baseline_novelty_definition: mean of within-period novelty-seeking over purchasing periods
baseline_order_adjustment: standardized log(1 + baseline orders), fully interacted with post, treatment, and predicted incidence
formula: variety_seeking ~ post_X_treated + post_X_incidence + post_X_treated_X_incidence + post_X_baseline_novelty + post_X_treated_X_baseline_novelty + post_X_incidence_X_baseline_novelty + post_X_treated_X_incidence_X_baseline_novelty + post_X_baseline_log_orders + post_X_treated_X_baseline_log_orders + post_X_incidence_X_baseline_log_orders + post_X_treated_X_incidence_X_baseline_log_orders | event_fe_id + rel_t + calendar_month
formula_without_baseline_order_adjustmen: variety_seeking ~ post_X_treated + post_X_incidence + post_X_treated_X_incidence + post_X_baseline_novelty + post_X_treated_X_baseline_novelty + post_X_incidence_X_baseline_novelty + post_X_treated_X_incidence_X_baseline_novelty | event_fe_id + rel_t + calendar_month
